executive.headline: Unreachable to AI from this vantage.
executive.summary: The server returns HTTP 404 (page not found) to plain automated requests — a common way to disguise a bot/geo block as a missing page rather than an explicit refusal. Treated as unreachable from this external vantage. The service page couldn't be reached, so legibility and obstacles are unmeasured.
